question: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.year, T3.name, T3.date, T3.time FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 on T1.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T1.driverId = ( SELECT driverId FROM drivers ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY T3.date ASC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT 
    MIN(races.date) AS race_date, 
    drivers.forename, 
    drivers.surname, 
    races.time 
FROM 
    drivers 
JOIN 
    qualifying ON drivers.driverId = qualifying.driverId 
JOIN 
    races ON qualifying.raceId = races.raceId 
WHERE 
    drivers.dob IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY 
    drivers.driverId 
ORDER BY 
    drivers.dob DESC 
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: SELECT를 year, name, date, time 순서로 바꿔. 그리고 GROUP BY 방식 말고, 가장 어린 드라이버를 서브쿼리로 먼저 찾은 다음(ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1), 그 드라이버의 레이스만 date ASC로 정렬해서 1등 하나 뽑는 방식으로 써.
turns.sql:
SELECT 
    races.year, 
    drivers.forename || ' ' || drivers.surname AS name, 
    races.date, 
    races.time 
FROM 
    races 
JOIN 
    qualifying ON races.raceId = qualifying.raceId 
JOIN 
    drivers ON qualifying.driverId = drivers.driverId 
WHERE 
    drivers.driverId = (SELECT driverId 
                        FROM drivers 
                        WHERE dob IS NOT NULL 
                        ORDER BY dob DESC 
                        LIMIT 1) 
ORDER BY 
    races.date ASC 
LIMIT 1

turns.hint: name은 드라이버 이름이 아니라 레이스 이름(races.name)이야. drivers.forename/surname 합치지 말고 races.name 그대로 써.
turns.sql:
SELECT 
    races.year, 
    races.name, 
    races.date, 
    races.time 
FROM 
    races 
JOIN 
    qualifying ON races.raceId = qualifying.raceId 
JOIN 
    drivers ON qualifying.driverId = drivers.driverId 
WHERE 
    drivers.driverId = (SELECT driverId 
                        FROM drivers 
                        WHERE dob IS NOT NULL 
                        ORDER BY dob DESC 
                        LIMIT 1) 
ORDER BY 
    races.date ASC 
LIMIT 1

question: What is the average time in seconds of champion for each year, before year 1975?
gold_sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT T2.year, T2.raceId, T1.positionOrder, CASE WHEN T1.positionOrder = 1 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6,2) AS REAL )   + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 9) AS REAL)/1000 ELSE 0 END AS time_seconds FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.time IS NOT NULL ), champion_time AS ( SELECT year, raceId, time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = 1 ) SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) FROM champion_time WHERE year < 1975 GROUP BY year HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT s.year, AVG(strftime('%s', r.time)) AS average_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN seasons s ON ra.year = s.year
WHERE r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND s.year < 1975
GROUP BY s.year

turns.hint: seasons 테이블 조인할 필요 없어, races.year 그대로 쓰면 돼. r.position 말고 positionOrder = 1로 챔피언 판단해야 해. 그리고 strftime('%s', time)은 이 시간 형식(HH:MM:SS.mmm)엔 안 맞아 — 문자열을 시/분/초/밀리초로 직접 분리해서 초 단위로 변환해야 해 (시*3600 + 분*60 + 초 + 밀리초/1000).
turns.sql:
SELECT r.year, AVG(
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
) AS average_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE r.positionOrder = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY r.year

turns.hint: r.year가 아니라 ra.year를 써야 해 (results엔 year 컬럼 없어). 그리고 시간 형식이 "H:MM:SS.mmm"이야 — 시간이 한 자리 숫자야. substr 위치를 1(시,1자리), 3(분,2자리), 6(초,2자리), 9(밀리초)로 다시 잡아야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT ra.year, AVG(
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) +
    CAST(substr(r.time, 9, 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
) AS average_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE r.positionOrder = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY ra.year

question: How many accidents did the driver who had the highest number accidents in the Canadian Grand Prix have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN status AS T3 on T1.statusId = T3.statusId WHERE T3.statusId = 3 AND T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' GROUP BY T1.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(T1.driverId) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM results
WHERE driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (
        SELECT raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
    ) AND statusId = 3
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND statusId = 3

turns.hint: 'Canadian Grand Prix'라는 이름의 레이스가 여러 해에 걸쳐 여러 개 있어. raceId를 '='로 하나만 찾지 말고 races 테이블 이름으로 직접 JOIN해서 모든 해당 레이스를 포함해야 해. 그리고 마지막 COUNT도 그 드라이버의 전체 사고가 아니라 Canadian Grand Prix에서의 사고만 세야 해. GROUP BY driverId, ORDER BY COUNT DESC, LIMIT 1로 top 1명의 카운트를 구하는 방식으로.
turns.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE r.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    WHERE races.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND results.statusId = 3
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AND r.statusId = 3 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'

question: Please list the lap records for the circuits in Italy.
gold_sql: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) as time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime as lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) as min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 on fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy' ) AS T4 ON (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT r.circuitId, MIN(l.time) AS lapRecord
FROM lapTimes l
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
GROUP BY r.circuitId

turns.hint: lapTimes.time 말고 results.FastestLapTime 컬럼을 써야 해. 그리고 circuitId별로 그룹핑하는 게 아니라, 이탈리아 서킷 전체에서 가장 빠른 기록 1개만 찾아서 그 FastestLapTime 값 하나만 반환해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT MIN(r.fastestLapTime) AS fastestLapRecord
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'

question: Who is the champion of the Canadian Grand Prix in 2008? Indicate his finish time.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.time FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2008 AND T1.time LIKE '_:%:__.___'

turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1

turns.hint: 드라이버 이름은 빼고 time 컬럼만 SELECT해. position=1 조건 대신, time이 "시:분:초.밀리초" 형식(LIKE '_:%:__.___')인 행으로 챔피언을 판단해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT r.time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008 AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.time LIKE '_:%:__.___'

question: What are the maximum points of British constructors?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(T1.points) FROM constructorStandings AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 on T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId WHERE T2.nationality = 'British'

turns.sql:
SELECT MAX(points) AS max_points 
FROM constructors 
JOIN constructorResults ON constructors.constructorId = constructorResults.constructorId 
WHERE constructors.nationality = 'British'

turns.hint: constructorResults 말고 constructorStandings 테이블을 조인해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT MAX(cs.points) AS max_points 
FROM constructors c 
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId 
WHERE c.nationality = 'British'

question: Among all European Grand Prix races, what is the percentage of the races were hosted in Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.country = 'Germany' THEN T2.circuitID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.circuitId) FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'European Grand Prix'

turns.sql:
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'Germany' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM races
WHERE name = 'European Grand Prix'

turns.hint: races 테이블엔 country 컬럼이 없어. circuits 테이블을 circuitId로 조인해서 country를 가져와야 해. CAST도 REAL로 해줘.
turns.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS percentage
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'

question: Which drivers who were born in 1971 and has the fastest lap time on the race? Give id and code of these drivers.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.driverId, T2.code FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) = '1971' AND T1.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

turns.sql:
SELECT driverId, code 
FROM drivers 
WHERE strftime('%Y', dob) = '1971' 
AND driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM results WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL)

turns.hint: 서브쿼리(IN) 말고 results랑 drivers를 직접 JOIN해야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT d.driverId, d.code 
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971' 
AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL

question: Which race was Alex Yoong in when he was in track number less than 20?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Alex' AND T3.surname = 'Yoong' AND T2.position < 20

turns.sql:
SELECT r.name, r.date 
FROM results res 
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND res.position < 20

turns.hint: results 말고 driverStandings 테이블을 조인해야 해. 그리고 SELECT는 race name만, date는 빼.
turns.sql:
SELECT r.name 
FROM driverStandings ds 
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId 
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId 
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' AND d.surname = 'Yoong' AND ds.position < 20

question: In the race No. 45, for the driver who had the Q3 time as 0:01:33, what is his abbreviated code?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.code FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 45 AND T1.q3 LIKE '1:33%'

turns.sql:
SELECT d.code 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId 
WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '0:01:33%'

turns.hint: q3 형식이 '0:01:33'이 아니라 '1:33%'처럼 앞에 '0:0' 없이 저장돼 있어. LIKE '1:33%'로 바꿔야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT d.code 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId 
WHERE q.raceId = 45 AND q.q3 LIKE '1:33%'

question: Which driver ranked the first in the Canadian Grand Prix in 2007? Please give his reference name.
gold_sql: SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T2.rank = 1 AND T1.year = 2007

turns.sql:
SELECT d.driverRef
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.position = 1 AND r.year = 2007

turns.hint: year는 races 테이블에 있어, results가 아니라 ra.year로 써야 해. position 말고 rank = 1로 판단해야 하고, SELECT에 forename, surname도 같이 넣어야 해 (driverRef 하나만이 아니라 세 개 다).
turns.sql:
SELECT d.driverRef, d.forename, d.surname
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.rank = 1

turns.hint: 컬럼 순서를 forename, surname, driverRef 순으로 바꿔야 해.
turns.sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.driverRef
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2007 AND r.rank = 1

question: Which constructor scored most points from Monaco Grand Prix between 1980 and 2010? List the score, name and nationality of this team.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.points), T2.name, T2.nationality FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN constructors AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T3.raceid = T1.raceid WHERE T3.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND T3.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY T2.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.points) DESC LIMIT 1

turns.sql:
SELECT SUM(cr.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1
